name: aidd-team
description: Run the aidd loop as a delivery team: product-manager, architect, product-designer, security-engineer, compliance-analyst, tester, developer, ml-engineer, data-engineer, platform-engineer, tech-writer, verifier, reviewer, sre, and agile-coach agents, each applying its discipline's standards and writing only its own files, plus a domain pack per domain (web, APIs, mobile, AI features, AI agents, data, cloud, payments, health, embedded, public sector, children, internationalization) and practice skills for kinds of work such as API design, schema migration, threat modeling, test design, estimation, proposals, and release rollout. Ships one command per team flow: onboard, propose, plan, specify, implement, verify, review, sweep, secure, ship, postmortem, and retro. Works with git alone; a forge, a tracker, or any other service is optional. Depends on the aidd plugin, which carries the hook that checks each role's writes and denies approvals and merges; without it the roles only follow their instructions.
